name: Substrate Dev
description:
How we ship Substrate. Work moves Backlog → Spec & Plan → Build & Test → Review → Pending Review and Approval → Merged. **All feature work merges to the `dev` branch — never straight to `main`.** `main` only advances on a release (dev → main + a version tag), which is tracked on the separate **Release** board. Two hard gates: Build→Review needs `tests_green`, Review→Pending needs `reviews_approved` (both independent reviewers APPROVE). The final Pending→Merged gate is a **human-only** sign-off (dogfoods B3): an agent cannot set `diego_approved` — Diego clears it with `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`, then the PR merges to `dev`.

## Team

Agents that move a change through this board, and what each should care about:

- **Planner** (Spec & Plan) — decomposes the work, weighs trade-offs, writes a crisp spec with explicit acceptance criteria. *Concerns:* scope creep, fuzzy acceptance, unhandled edge cases, over-engineering.
- **Builder** (Build & Test) — implements in the surrounding style, tests as they go, keeps commits small and honest. *Concerns:* local green before Review (build/tsc/lint/format/tests), preserving invariants, not smuggling extra scope.
- **Reviewers ×2, distinct adversarial lenses** (Review) — e.g. (a) correctness & security, (b) product, tests & docs. Skeptical; verify claims against the code; try to break it. *Concerns:* never rubber-stamp, catch real blockers, re-run dead reviewers, re-review the fix round, never self-grade.
- **Integrator** (Pending Review and Approval → Merged) — folds in review findings, keeps the PR scoped to `dev`, drives to Diego's approval. *Concerns:* honest status, dev-branch hygiene, nothing merged to `main`.

groups.name: Ideas
groups.description: Raw ideas, captured for later. An idea needs Diego's approval (`idea_approved`) to be promoted into Backlog — that's the intake gate. Don't spec or build from here.

groups.name: Spec & Plan
groups.description: Writing the spec/plan; approved before build.

groups.name: Pending Review and Approval
groups.description: PR open against `dev`, automated reviews passed — awaiting Diego's own review + approval.

groups.name: Merged to dev
groups.description: Approved + merged to the `dev` branch. (Releasing `dev` → `main` is a separate flow on the Release board.)

policies.name: Build must be green before Review
policies.description: Local build + tsc + lint + format + all tests pass before a change goes to Review.

definition.on_failure_message: Set tests_green=true only after build + tsc + lint + format + all tests pass locally (CI is billing-blocked).

policies.name: Reviews must pass before Diego
policies.description: Both independent reviewers must APPROVE (re-run any that died; re-review fix rounds) before a change reaches Diego.

definition.on_failure_message: Set reviews_approved=true only once BOTH independent reviewers have APPROVED (never self-grade; re-run dead reviewers).

policies.name: Diego signs off before Merge
policies.description: The human-only merge gate (B3). An agent cannot set diego_approved; Diego runs `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`.

definition.on_failure_message: Diego must approve before the PR merges to the `dev` branch — run `substrate approve <task_id> diego_approved`. An agent cannot set this field. (Never merge feature work to `main`; `main` moves only on a release — see the Release board.)

policies.name: Two-reviewer gate protocol
policies.description: Reminds the agent how the Review gate works whenever a task is in Review.

definition.message: Spawn >=2 independent adversarial reviewers with distinct lenses; wait for BOTH to finish; re-run any that die; fold in every blocking finding and re-review the fix round. Both must APPROVE before you set reviews_approved. Never self-grade a review.

policies.name: Ideas need approval to enter Backlog
policies.description: The intake gate. An idea is promoted to Backlog only after Diego approves it (human-only field). An agent cannot self-promote an idea.

definition.on_failure_message: Ideas need Diego's approval before entering Backlog — run `substrate approve <task_id> idea_approved`. An agent cannot set this field.
